name: ENGTEX
recent: Engtex 最新季度（截至2026年9月30日）净利报830万令吉，市场关注雪兰莪与槟城大型水务项目带来的合约管道。同期董事局成员在公开市场及凭单转换中增持股份，公司亦持续进行股份回购。
notable: 最新季度（截至2026年9月30日）净利报830万令吉。
集团董事经理Tan Sri Dato' Ng Hook于2026年10月1日通过直接商业交易增持400万股。
执行董事Ng Yik Soon于2026年11月6日以每股0.390令吉增持60万股。
risks: 董事及主要股东在闭门期前后有多笔股份交易，包括增持及凭单转换。
公司于2026年9月至10月期间多次进行股份回购。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收3.734亿令吉，净利1,200万令吉，净利率3.2%；营收环比增15.7%，净利环比增34.1%；营收同比增8.5%，净利同比增335.5%。

recent_en: Engtex reported a net profit of RM8.3 million for the latest quarter ended 30 September 2026, with market attention on contract flows from large-scale water projects in Selangor and Penang.
notable_en: Reported a net profit of RM8.3 million for the latest quarter ended 30 September 2026.
Group Managing Director Tan Sri Dato' Ng Hook acquired 4 million shares via direct business transaction on 1 October 2026.
Executive Director Ng Yik Soon acquired 600,000 shares at RM0.390 per share on 6 November 2026.
risks_en: There were multiple share transactions by directors and substantial shareholders around the closed period, including acquisitions and warrant conversions.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM373.4 million and net income was RM12.0 million, with a net margin of 3.2%; revenue rose 15.7% QoQ and net income rose 34.1% QoQ; revenue grew 8.5% YoY and net income grew 335.5% YoY.
